_about: The SE demo kit's Endpoint AI policy. The kit sets every rule's verdict from the mode (monitor -> audit, block -> block), checks the rules with POST /v1/policies/validate, and assigns the policy only to the kit's device group. Rules marked optional are added only with the shell-lock option. 'scene' and 'optional' are the kit's own keys and are stripped before sending.
